# DayCard

One of the seven daily forecast cards: weekday and date, condition icon, hi/lo, precipitation probability, wind, comfort badge.

`WeatherExplorer.DayCard` · Forecast

## Use

```jsx
<WeatherExplorer.DayCard date="…" hi={0} lo={0} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="WeatherExplorer.DayCard" date="…" hi="{{0}}" lo="{{0}}"></x-import>
```
